threads.body: This suite records the connect spans only in legacy semconv mode. Because `testStableSemconv` now runs with connection telemetry disabled, metadata collection never observes the `service.peer.name` emitted by `maybeStablePeerService()` in stable mode, so regenerating the instrumentation list drops that existing attribute. Add and collect another suite with both connection telemetry and `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in=database,service.peer` enabled.

Collecting this task restores only legacy `peer.service`: its JVM configuration does not opt into stable service-peer semconv, while `testStableSemconv` skips the connect-only tests. As a result, regeneration removes `service.peer.name` from Lettuce 5.0's stable metadata. Also define and collect a task that enables both connection telemetry and `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in=database,service.peer`.
